sprint: Magic Publish — Sprint M6 (Publish Celebration). Per docs/MAGIC_PUBLISH_ROADMAP.md: "Publishing should become an experience, not an export." Scope: replace the single "Publishing..." line with a live checklist (✨ Preparing Story / ✨ Creating Magic / ✓ Book Ready / ✓ Magic Ready), and have the Celebration page automatically play the Magic Creation with no download required, while downloads remain available. Success criteria: the child watches the animation immediately after publishing. Design per docs/MAGIC_PUBLISH_ARCHITECTURE.md section 7.2: "Choose Story Destination becomes optional, reachable as 'Other formats' from Celebration... The default path has no fork in it at all", and "Celebration presents four things to keep, with the Magic Creation already playing. Not a download button — a playing video. The celebration IS the artifact."
task: The bundle is three destination tasks run in sequence — book/digital, magic/vertical, strip/strip — plus the cover, which is NOT a destination: _enterCelebration already renders it live from the slide, so it costs nothing and is the fourth "thing to keep" section 7.2 names. Two disclosed departures from the roadmap's literal text. First, the roadmap's four lines are 2 tasks x 2 states (active -> done), not four separate lines, and the Strip gets a third row in the same shape (✨ Printing the Strip -> ✓ Strip Ready) — additive beyond the literal copy, because a task that runs silently while two others announce themselves reads as a bug. Second, the bundle runs to completion BEFORE Celebration rather than taking section 7.3 mitigation 1 (show Celebration early, film the magic behind it): the most literal reading of "The child watches the animation immediately after publishing" is that the animation is ready when Celebration opens, and a sequential loop is simpler and far more testable than a background compose racing a visible stage. Section 7.3's "never block Celebration" rule is honored for FAILURE — a task that returns null still advances the checklist and still reaches Celebration, so a child never sees an error about a thing they did not ask for. New _publishMode ('bundle' | 'single') is what keeps every existing test byte-identical: _confirmDestination() forces 'single', so any caller that drives DESTINATION -> pick -> continue behaves exactly as before, and open() plus the Almost Ready button reset it to 'bundle'. _publishedBlob()/_publishedFilename()/_downloadPublished() keep returning the PRIMARY artifact (the book in bundle mode, the chosen destination in single mode), which is the regression-critical contract every magic/reel/voice suite polls. _completeBundle restores _publishDestination/_publishFormat to the primary after the loop, because Celebration's existing destination-aware copy reads _publishDestination and would otherwise still be pointing at whichever task ran last. Celebration shows the Magic Creation playing inside the existing .publish-celebration-book stand (aspect-ratio switched to 1080/1920 when the video shows, cover shown otherwise), with controls left on as the real-world fallback if a browser blocks autoplay, an object URL revoked both on re-entry and in _close(), a quiet row of keep pills for everything the bundle produced beyond the primary, and "Other formats" routing to the destination picker whose Back link returns to Celebration rather than Almost Ready. renderer/slideRenderer.js is NOT touched, so Museum Gallery's canonical hashes are not the gate for this ship. Verified 35/35 via magic_m6_verify across eight sections: no fork on the default path; the checklist rows and their live active->done transitions, captured with a MutationObserver rather than polling; three artifacts produced with the book PDF as primary (magic bytes read off the blob itself); the celebration video genuinely PLAYING (paused false, currentTime > 0, with Chromium launched under --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required so the assertion is decisive), the keeps row, its !important sizing, the bundle-aware headline and a real download; "Other formats" -> picker -> Back -> Celebration; the single-destination path still working end to end; a deliberately failed task still reaching Celebration; and zero page errors. Three test-methodology bugs were found and fixed in the suite, none of them app bugs: the expected PDF magic was written 2550444625 when %PDF- is 255044462d; a 60ms interval observer never sampled the book row in its active state because the PDF encode finishes inside one poll tick, fixed by switching to a MutationObserver on .publish-checklist; and five suites (magic_m1/m3/m4/m5, reel) pressed the Almost Ready primary expecting the destination picker — exactly the fork M6 removes — so each was repointed to _setStage('destination'), the intended and disclosed consequence of the redesign rather than a regression, deliberately without pressing the primary first, which would leave a bundle publish running in the background. Regression: magic_m1 32/32, magic_m2 33/33, magic_m3 32/32, magic_m4 41/41, magic_m5 43/43, reel 15/15, reel_backdrop 10/10, reel_pageturn 12/12, voice 16/16, voice_note 22/22, both goldenBuilds PASS.
